1. RECRUITER JOB CONTROLLER & RBAC PERMISSION MATRIX
• Route Guard: Protected by career_recruiter_session cookie via edge middleware
• Multi-Tenant Context: Injects companyId = auth.company.id & company = auth.company.name
• Audit Logging: Automatically creates JOB_CREATED and JOB_PUBLISHED audit records
Job Management Permissions across 6 Recruiter Roles
✓ jobs:view (Strictly scoped to assignedJobIds array in membership)
✓ jobs:view (Read-only visibility to coordinate candidate interviews)
✗ No jobs permissions (Restricted entirely to assigned interviews)
ENFORCEMENT: RecruiterRbacService throws RecruiterAuthError(403) if unauthorized role calls jobs:create
company String (Denormalized employer name for fast display)
status JobStatus @default(DRAFT) (Enum: DRAFT, PUBLISHED, CLOSED, EXPIRED)
skills String[] (Array of skills for candidate match percentage)
publishedAt DateTime? (Canonical publication timestamp set when status -> PUBLISHED)
expiresAt DateTime? (Pre-calculated exact expiration: publishedAt + 30 days)
applications JobApplication[] (Relational array of submitted applications)
INDEX PATTERN: @@index([companyId, status]) & @@index([status, publishedAt]) for ultra-fast query execution
• getExpirationThreshold(now) returns UTC Date: new Date(now.getTime() - EXPIRATION_MS)
• Timezone safe: All evaluations operate on ISO UTC millisecond timestamps, preventing daylight saving flaws.
• Direct status check: Returns true immediately if job.status === 'EXPIRED'
• Timestamp check: If status === 'PUBLISHED', evaluates if now.getTime() >= publishedAt + 30 days
• Fallback handling: If publishedAt is null (legacy jobs), checks createdAt + 30 days
where: { status: 'PUBLISHED', OR: [{ publishedAt: { lte: threshold } }, { expiresAt: { lte: now } }] },
✓ IDEMPOTENCY: Executing this function 100 times daily causes zero side effects on already expired jobs.
Checks for Authorization: Bearer CRON_SECRET or x-cron-secret
Fallback authorization: Authenticated ADMIN session via SESSION_COOKIE_NAME
Supports both GET (Vercel Cron default) and POST (custom external cron runners).
Configured via Next.js export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic' to bypass edge caching.
1. Database Layer: Job status is updated to EXPIRED, instantly excluding it from status: PUBLISHED queries.
2. Runtime Safety Query Filter: Even before cron fires, queries include publishedAt: { gt: expirationThreshold }.
Recruiter job list displays an "EXPIRED" badge for jobs older than 30 days, keeping recruiters informed.
Recruiters can filter jobs by status: ALL | DRAFT | PUBLISHED | CLOSED | EXPIRED.
RESULT: Zero candidate visibility for jobs older than 30 days. No stale postings on candidate boards.
throw new Error('This job is no longer accepting applications.');
• Immediate HTTP 400 Bad Request: Returned if a candidate attempts to submit to an expired job.
• Automatic Storage Rollback: Any newly uploaded resume file is instantly purged from disk on rejection.
• Recruiter Review Retained: Existing applicants remain in the pipeline; hiring team can continue interviewing.
